name: Welcome to the crew
why: New members decide in the first few days whether the app is worth keeping. A welcome that shows the prize counter, then one nudge to book a cage if they haven't been back, turns sign-ups into regulars.
timing_text: Right away · day 4 if they haven't been back
reward_text: Points on every visit and every dollar (your point rules)

messages.label: Email: welcome
messages.subject: You're in, {{first_name}}! Your {{business}} rewards are live
messages.preheader: Points on every visit, prizes at the counter.
messages.heading: Welcome to the crew, {{first_name}}
messages.body:
Every visit and every dollar you spend earns points. Trade them at the prize counter for arcade credit, food, toys and cage time.

Show your QR code at the counter each time you come in and your points stack up automatically.
messages.footnote: Tip: show your QR code at the counter on every visit

messages.label: Email: book a cage
messages.when_text: Day 4, if they haven't been in
messages.subject: Ready to play, {{first_name}}?
messages.preheader: Reserve a cage or a pool table so it's ready when you walk in.
messages.heading: Grab a cage, bring a friend
messages.body:
Reserve a batting cage or a pool table in the app and it's waiting for you when you walk in.

Your points start the moment you check in, and the first prizes are closer than you think.

name: Points scoreboard
why: After a visit or a purchase, players see their new score next to the prizes it gets them closer to. At most one a week, and never during the welcome week or right after an unlock email.

messages.label: Email: scoreboard
messages.subject: Scoreboard update: {{points}} points, {{first_name}}
messages.preheader: Here's what your points get you at {{business}}.
messages.heading: You're at {{points}} points
messages.body: Nice playing. Here's what your points can get you at the prize counter, and what's up next.

name: Almost there
why: When a player gets within a quarter of their next prize, one email tells them exactly how close they are. A close goal is the best reason to come back this week.
trigger_text: Points reach 75% of the next prize
reward_text: The next prize on their list

messages.label: Email: so close
messages.subject: {{first_name}}, you're {{points_remaining}} points from {{offer_name}}
messages.preheader: One more visit should do it.
messages.heading: So close: {{offer_name}}
messages.body: Just {{points_remaining}} more points and it's yours. One more visit should do it: every check-in and every dollar at the counter adds up.

name: Prize unlocked
why: The moment a player's points cross a prize's cost they get a big photo email of it with a Redeem button. If they haven't redeemed anything two weeks later, one reminder shows them what's waiting.
timing_text: Right away · 14 days later if nothing redeemed

messages.label: Email: you unlocked it
messages.subject: 🎉 You unlocked {{offer_name}}, {{first_name}}!
messages.preheader: It's ready at the prize counter on your next visit.
messages.heading: You unlocked {{offer_name}}!
messages.body: Tap Redeem in the app, then show your code at the counter on your next visit.

messages.label: Email: prizes waiting
messages.subject: Your prizes are waiting at {{business}}
messages.preheader: Points don't do much sitting in the app.
messages.heading: Don't leave them on the shelf
messages.body: Points don't do much sitting in the app. Take a look at what yours get you, tap Redeem, then show the code at the counter.

name: Prize expiring soon
why: A prize a player already redeemed in the app but hasn't picked up at the counter gets one email three days before it expires, so nothing goes to waste.
trigger_text: A redeemed prize expires in 3 days

messages.label: Email: pick it up
messages.subject: Your {{offer_name}} expires {{due_date}}
messages.preheader: Show your code at the counter before then.
messages.heading: Pick it up before {{due_date}}
messages.body: Your {{offer_name}} is saved in the app until {{due_date}}. Show your code at the counter on your next visit and it's yours.

name: Google review for points
why: The day after a visit, while the fun is fresh, players who haven't reviewed you get one ask with your review points. Then never again for 4 months. Points land when the desk verifies it.
trigger_text: Someone checks in, no review yet
timing_text: The next day · max 1 every 4 months
reward_text: Your review points, added when the review is verified

messages.label: Email: review for points
messages.subject: Got 30 seconds? Get +{{bonus}} points
messages.preheader: A quick Google review, and the points are yours.
messages.heading: How was your visit?
messages.body:
If you had fun at {{business}}, a quick Google review helps other families find us.

Once it's verified we'll add {{bonus}} points to your card.
messages.footnote: +{{bonus}} points when your review is verified

name: Bring your crew
why: Regulars are the best source of new players. From the third visit on, the day after a visit, they get one nudge to share their invite link. Both people get points.
trigger_text: A check-in by someone with 3+ visits
timing_text: The next day · max 1 every 3 months
reward_text: Your referral points for both people

messages.label: Email: bring a friend
messages.subject: Bring a friend, you both get points
messages.heading: More players, more points
messages.body:
Know someone who'd love {{business}}? Share your invite link from the app.

When they join and check in, you get {{bonus}} points and they get {{friend_bonus}}.
messages.footnote: +{{bonus}} points for you, +{{friend_bonus}} for your friend

name: We miss you
why: Players who haven't been in for 45 days get a friendly email with their points, then a comeback bonus two weeks later if they still haven't visited. The bonus only lands if they actually check in.
reward_text: +1,000 points if they check in within 2 weeks of the bonus email

messages.label: Email: we miss you
messages.subject: The cages miss you, {{first_name}}
messages.heading: It's been {{days_since_last_visit}} days!
messages.body: Your {{points}} points are still on your card, and the prize counter is stocked. Swing by for a round, a game or a slice.

messages.label: Email: comeback bonus
messages.subject: A comeback bonus for you: +{{bonus}} points
messages.preheader: Check in within 2 weeks and they're yours.
messages.heading: Come back, score +{{bonus}} points
messages.body: Check in at {{business}} in the next 2 weeks and we'll add {{bonus}} bonus points to your card, on top of everything you earn that day.
messages.footnote: +{{bonus}} bonus points when you check in within 14 days

name: Birthday party planner
why: Three weeks before a member's birthday they get one email inviting them to throw the party with you. Party bookings are your biggest tickets, and weekends fill early.
trigger_text: A member's birthday is 3 weeks away

messages.label: Email: party invite
messages.subject: {{first_name}}, your birthday's coming up 🎂
messages.preheader: Party room, cages, arcade and pizza. We'll handle the fun.
messages.heading: Party at {{business}}?
messages.body:
Your birthday is about 3 weeks away. Party room, batting cages, arcade and pizza: we handle the fun, you bring the crew.

Weekends go fast, so grab your spot early.

name: Happy birthday
why: On their birthday, members get a birthday email with their points and prizes. Your birthday gift offer (if you have one) still arrives in the app as before.
reward_text: Your birthday gift offer, if you have one

messages.label: Email: happy birthday
messages.subject: Happy birthday, {{first_name}}! 🎉
messages.preheader: Come celebrate with us this week.
messages.heading: Happy birthday from {{business}}!
messages.body: Come celebrate with us this week. Your points are waiting, and so is the prize counter.
